statements.t: Based on our significant operating leverage, firm fixtures to date, and the current FFA curve, we reiterate a projected dividend of over $1 per share in Q4.

2 Q4 2026 projected dividend shown is based on fixtures to date (currently representing 66% of our owned fleet available days), assuming the current FFA curve for the balance of the quarter and estimated expense levels and utilization as described in the appendix to our Q3 2026 earnings presentation posted on our website under “Investors – Events and Presentations.” Given freight market volatility, the FFA curve…
The voluntary quarterly reserve for the fourth quarter of 2026 under the Company’s dividend formula is targeted at $19.5 million, which remains fully within our discretion.

Subject to the development of freight rates for the remainder of the fourth quarter and our assessment of our liquidity and forward outlook, we maintain flexibility to reduce the quarterly reserve to pay dividends or increase the amount of dividends otherwise payable under our formula.
The reserve is set by our Board of Directors in its discretion, and our Board has generally set the reserve based on anticipated debt prepayments plus an additional amount.
We plan to set the voluntary reserve each quarter for the next quarter.
Benefitting from a firm drybulk market, industry low breakeven levels, and an 18% net loan-to-value, we expect another strong dividend in the fourth quarter.
In addition to acquisitions that we may undertake, we will incur additional capital expenditures due to special surveys and drydockings.
Furthermore, we plan to upgrade a portion of our fleet with energy saving devices and apply high performance paint systems to our vessels in order to reduce fuel consumption and emissions.
We expect to fund these costs with cash on hand.
